description: Execute contact model methods on existing contacts. The specified method, along with its arguments, is invoked for all contacts in the range that have a contact model supporting that method. Methods are model-specific functions that perform specialized operations like activating bonds, setting deformability parameters, or other model-specific behaviors. By default, only mechanical contacts are considered.

methods.description: Execute a contact model method on a contact object

parameters.args: Dictionary with string keys for method arguments (optional)

notes: Python SDK requires iteration over contacts - cannot execute method on all contacts in one call
Method arguments must be passed as a dictionary (not name-value pairs)
Command interface is more efficient for bulk method execution
Use range specification in command interface to avoid Python iteration

6.0: Live 6.0 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>'); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself.
7.0: Live 7.0 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>'); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself.
9.0: Live 9.7 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>' / 'contact fluid <sub>' - fluid is 9.x-new); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself.

keywords.name: area
keywords.description: Set the user_area property to the contact's current area. Models: arrlinear, flatjoint, linear, linearcbond, lineardipole, linearpbond, mohr, rrlinear, softbond, springnetwork, subspringnetwork.

keywords.name: assign-stiffness
keywords.description: Assign the stiffness without Poisson correction: kn is the normal stiffness, kratio the normal-to-shear stiffness ratio. Models: springnetwork, subspringnetwork.

keywords.name: bond
keywords.description: Bond the contact if its gap lies in the gap interval. flatjoint bonds one element ('element <i>') or all elements; smoothjoint bonds the joint; softbond also takes 'soft <f>' (softening parameter) and 'cut <f>' (softening threshold parameter). Models: flatjoint, linearcbond, linearpbond, smoothjoint, softbond, springnetwork, subspringnetwork.

keywords.name: cb_strength
keywords.description: Set the contact-bond tensile and shear strength [stress]. Model: linearcbond.

keywords.name: compute-stiffness
keywords.description: Compute the stiffnesses with Poisson correction from Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio. Models: springnetwork, subspringnetwork.

keywords.name: deformability
keywords.description: Set the deformability: emod is the effective modulus, kratio the normal-to-shear stiffness ratio. By convention kratio 0.0 sets the shear stiffness to zero without changing the normal stiffness. Models: arrlinear, flatjoint, linear, linearcbond, lineardipole, linearpbond, rrlinear, softbond.

keywords.name: initialize
keywords.description: Initialize the forces and moment from the total local force and total local moment. Model: flatjoint.

keywords.name: make_dry
keywords.description: Remove moisture: the moisture state becomes dry (mois_state 0). The moisture force updates on the next cycle. Model: hill.

keywords.name: make_wet
keywords.description: Add moisture if the contact gap is at most the moisture gap given: the moisture state becomes wet (mois_state 2). The moisture force updates on the next cycle. Model: hill.

keywords.name: pb_deformability
keywords.description: Set the parallel-bond deformability: emod is the bond effective modulus, kratio the bond normal-to-shear stiffness ratio. Model: linearpbond.

keywords.name: sj_setforce
keywords.description: Set the joint force. Model: smoothjoint.

keywords.name: unbond
keywords.description: Unbond the contact if its gap lies in the gap interval. flatjoint unbonds one element ('element <i>') or all elements; smoothjoint unbonds the joint. Models: flatjoint, linearcbond, linearpbond, smoothjoint, softbond, springnetwork, subspringnetwork.

examples.command: contact method bond gap 0.0 pb_deformability emod 60e9 kratio 2.5
examples.description: Bond contacts with parallel bond model and set parallel bond stiffnesses from material properties (from SRM specimen example) (model: linearpbond).

examples.command: contact method bond range contact active
examples.description: Activate bonds on all active contacts (from rigid block tunnel excavation) (model: linearpbond or linearcbond).
Set parallel bond stiffnesses based on elastic modulus and stiffness ratio (model: linearpbond).
Set linear component stiffnesses from material properties for all contacts (model: linear, linearpbond, linearcbond, etc.).

examples.command: contact method bond gap 1e-6 range group 'specimen'
examples.description: Bond contacts in 'specimen' group allowing small initial gap (model: linearpbond or linearcbond).

examples.command: contact method deformability emod 50e9 kratio 1.5 range contact type 'ball-ball'
examples.description: Set stiffnesses for ball-ball contacts only (model: any model with deformability method).
